record: City of Tagajo central government remains
facts: The central government enclosure measured 103 by 116 metres and contained the main hall, side halls, rear hall and ancillary buildings. Earthmoving shaped the hilltop before construction.
The central main hall stood on a raised platform. The inner south gate and rear hall followed the main north-south axis.

record: City of Tagajo outer south gate
facts: The modern full-sized outer gate is a separate structure outside the central enclosure covered by this model.
The 1 m grid gives bare ground elevation in the national vertical datum.
